description: This file defines API interaction functions for a frontend application, including methods for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests, as well as specific functions for handling work items and comments.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Builds request headers including Authorization token if available.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON payload.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON payload.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific work item.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items filtered by project ID if provided.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item like a task or bug.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given API path.

ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
